{{Quote|I may not be one of your kind, young human, but I can tell you something universal. You let a woman into your life, and anything can happen.|The Keshiri bartender|<ref name="sentinel" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] '''bartender''' [[Bartender/Legends|tended]] a [[Unidentified bar (Kesh)|bar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Kind to his patrons, he always tried to have a decent meal to serve for the poor. He offered the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jelph Marrian]] food and advice when the [[Human/Legends|Human]] entered his bar in [[3960 BBY]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I think&hellip;I might have ruined my life.''"<br />"''Sounds like you met a woman. Do you want me to leave the bottle?|Jelph Marrian and the Keshiri bartender|<ref name="sentinel" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], where he tended a [[Unidentified bar (Kesh)|bar]] near the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tahv]] in [[3960 BBY]]. He was generous and always tried to have a decent meal to offer [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and the poor when they entered his bar. When a morose [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Jelph Marrian]] entered the establishment, the elderly bartender sensed Marrian's sadness and guessed that the Human was concerned over a [[Orielle Kitai|woman]]. The bartender poured him a mug of [[sweetwater]] and offered to leave the bottle should the Human need more. The Keshiri also served Marrian a bowl of [[Porridge/Legends|porridge]] out of concern over his woe and gave him kind words and pieces of love advice, telling him that anything could happen when he involved himself with a woman.<ref name="sentinel" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I always try to have something to serve for the poor. I'm sorry it's not better.|The Keshiri bartender|<ref name="sentinel" />}}
The [[Color/Legends|purple]]-skinned Keshiri bartender was pleasant and generous to his patrons, offering kind words in addition to food and beverages. When the impoverished or the enslaved entered his bar, he was quick to provide them with a meal and prompt to apologize when he believed they did not enjoy it. Perceptive to the emotions of others, the Keshiri was able to sense Marrian's solemn mood, discerning that the Human had strong feelings for a woman.<ref name="sentinel" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|When I did revisions on the story for the prose collection, I thought seriously about giving the dude a name &ndash; but why spoil the fun? (If pressed, I’d suggest '''Yukaybee''', which would sound out the acronym of his Wookieepedia name!)|John Jackson Miller|<ref name="Faraway" />}}
The bartender was created by [[John Jackson Miller]] for ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Sentinel]]'', the sixth [[eBook]] in the [[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith|''Lost Tribe of the Sith'']] series.<ref name="sentinel" /> When doing revisions on the story for ''[[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith: The Collected Stories]]'', Miller considered giving the character a name but decided against it.<ref name="Faraway">{{Faraway|url=fiction/ebooks/sw-losttribeofthesith6.html|text=''Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith Part 6: Sentinel''}}</ref>
